common_suffix_diameter: supremal declared-output distance between histories sharing the last d inputs
emulation_statement: a growing exact-expectation reset-QELM family universal on each finite window emulates uniformly to arbitrary accuracy exactly when D_d tends to zero
figure_question: when can explicit finite context reproduce recurrent input-output behavior
memory_relevance: past inputs must create the state difference and present or future declared outputs must reveal it; full-state forgetting is not required

panels.a: recurrent quantum state versus reset-window input-output emulation
panels.c: uniformly fading relevant memory versus persistent visible memory

fading.condition: D_d is positive at every finite d and tends to zero; r_vis < 1

finite.consequence: output exactly determined by finite context

persistent.condition: D_d >= Delta > 0 for every d; r_vis = 1
persistent.consequence: scalar worst-case error is at least Delta/2

scope: finite-dimensional QRC with input-continuous channels and fixed finite observable output; the iff statement additionally assumes compact inputs with freely concatenable suffixes and per-window reset-QELM density
typography: native 9.5-10.5 pt text at 7.055 inch width
